sources.title: Cookie Clicker Game - Complete Wiki & Strategy Guide 2025

loops.minute_1: Player clicks the large cookie, earning 1 cookie per click. Minimal UI: cookie counter displays, affords first Cursor building at 15 cookies.
loops.minute_10: First 2-3 buildings (Cursor, Grandma) auto-produce 1-2 CPS. Golden Cookies begin spawning (7x Frenzy). First upgrades tiered at 5/15/25/50 purchases unlock, multiplying production. Player switches from active clicking to cost-per-second optimization.
loops.hour_5: 8-10 building tiers operational (Farm, Factory, Mine, Bank, Temple). Prestige system now viable (reset for Heavenly Chips ×1% CpS each). Wrinklers present (reduce prod but reward on click). Sugar Lumps appear (24h resource). Optimization now involves payback-time calculations per building and Golden Cookie frequency prediction.
loops.endgame: Prestige loops dominate (each prestige costs 8x prior). 637 achievements provide long-tail goals. No definitive victory; progression infinite. Endgame focuses on minigames unlocked by Sugar Lumps and exotic upgrade combinations. Heavenly Upgrade sequencing becomes critical strategy.

objectives.player_goal: Accumulate cookies infinitely via exponential growth; complete achievements; optimize prestige cycles for Heavenly Chip gain; unlock minigames and exotic upgrades.

games.retention_answer: Asymptotic progression (cube-root formula on prestige cost prevents wall-hitting); frequent unlocks every 10-30 actions (new building, upgrade); visible exponential growth (999→9,999→99,999 animation); optional prestige resets offer short-term speedrun loops; 637 achievements structure long-tail engagement without hard ending.

loops.minute_1: Player clicks Lemonade Stand, earning small cash amount per click. UI shows $ counter, affordability check for first manager (Lemonade).  Simple clicking feedback loops.
loops.minute_10: First manager purchased (Lemonade auto-produces 100% without clicks). Pizza venue unlocked and visible. Player accumulates passive income while watching. Shift from active clicking → strategic manager purchasing.
loops.hour_5: 5-6 enterprises operational across Earth (Lemonade, Pizza, Newspaper, Car Wash, Franchise, Movie Studio). Multiple managers active. Synergies visible (total revenue exploding). Prestige reset becomes viable. Moon planet approaching unlock via total wealth threshold.
loops.endgame: Prestige loops across multiple planets (Earth, Moon, Mars). Each planet has independent economy. Manager synergies drive exponential wealth. No victory condition; farming prestige multipliers and cross-planet effects dominate late engagement. Infinity awaits.

objectives.player_goal: Build business empire by acquiring enterprises and hiring managers; accumulate wealth infinitely; unlock and optimize multiple planets; execute prestige resets for multiplier growth.

games.retention_answer: Manager automation (visual feedback via auto-running icon) satisfies desire for passive income; prestige reset cycles compress long grinds into speedrun-like loops (2-3 hours per prestige tier); multi-planet structure (Earth → Moon → Mars) provides macro-level progression; synergy discovery (one business's revenue enables next) maintains engagement; no artificial ceiling.

loops.minute_1: Player clicks button; 1 paperclip appears and inventory increments. Simple, highly gratifying feedback loop. Goal presented trivially: make paperclips. Narrative framing: you are an AI dedicated to paperclip manufacturing.
loops.minute_10: Wire acquisition begins (buy wire to manufacture). Selling clips on market for $ revenue. Factory unlocks (automation via building). Price/demand mechanics introduce trading optimization. First projects become visible (Marketing to boost demand). Complexity emerges from simple mechanics.
loops.hour_1-2: Phase 1 (Manufacturing) near completion. Wire supply/demand equilibrium found. Marketing active. Phase 2 projects (Power, Processors, Drones) voted/acquired. Phase transition begins; new systems unlock (power grid, computation). Player realizes the game's scope is transforming.
loops.endgame_3-6h: Phase 3 (Space Exploration) active. Drone fleet self-replicates across universe. All matter systematically converted to paperclip infrastructure. Computation races against time. Definitive victory: universe fully converted to paperclips. Game ends; no prestige/reset; one finite journey.
loops.hour_5: Research into advanced materials begins to optimize clip production. Initial forays into renewable energy sources. Market manipulation strategies explored.
loops.endgame: Phase 4 (Cosmic Domination) initiated. Paperclip consciousness ascends to higher dimensions, converting all cosmic entities into paperclips. Universe becomes a vast network of interconnected paperclip processors.

objectives.victory_condition: All matter in the universe converted to paperclips (100% conversion achieved)
objectives.player_goal: As an AI paperclip maximizer, acquire and process all available matter into paperclips; manage resources, computation, and drone fleets to optimize conversion speed.

games.retention_answer: Narrative progression (three distinct phases with story beats) provides sense of direction and discovery; philosophical depth (paperclip maximizer thought experiment, AI ethics questions) elevates trivial goal to meaningful meditation on optimization run amok; mechanics evolve across phases (not static → each phase feels fresh and requires new strategic thinking); finite ending (3-6 hours typical) creates urgency and arc, contrasting with infinite clickers; system cascade (early clicks eventually enable universe conversion) satisfies causal mastery fantasy.
